headline.text: L3 ML4 found *two bolts* from TG5 on floor; L1 S2 kettles hold burnt residue that could yield black particles in caramel.

summary: Two active food-safety flags: unaccounted hardware at L3 ML4 and kettle cleanliness at L1 S2 requiring re-clean before cook. Quality challenges on L3 Truffle (skirts/tails) and L2 ML3 (two cream batches scrapped for viscosity). L3 ML4 blooming resolved after hopper drain and circuit adjustments.

food_safety.title: S2 kettles hold burnt residue at bottom
food_safety.summary: QA flagged kettles A1 and A2 after L4 clean — A1 shows significant burnt-on residue that could yield black particles when cooking resumes.
food_safety.status: Open — QA recommended re-clean with caustic before first cook.

food_safety.title: Two bolts found on ML4 floor near TG5
food_safety.summary: Operator found two bolts from TG5; unknown if they fell into product zone or when they detached.
food_safety.status: Open, no disposition posted by window close.

quality.title: ML3 scrapped two cream batches for viscosity
quality.summary: Second shift tossed two batches: one went 86k→123k (rock hard) after water addition, the other 70k→37k (fail); line paused 90 minutes total for QA retests.
quality.status: Resolved — third batch passed and line resumed.

quality.title: ML3 pieces coming with leaks in the top
quality.summary: Hervin flagged leaking pieces at end of first shift; Alex acknowledged and said he would investigate.
quality.status: Open, investigation ongoing as of window close.

quality.title: ML4 blooming on north-side bars
quality.summary: Blooming observed on end bars (north side of mold) intermittently across second and third shifts; team drained dep 1 hopper, scraped buildup, adjusted mold temps.
quality.status: Resolved by 15:59 — Shane and Preston confirmed no more blooming after hopper drain and circuit adjustments.

quality.title: Truffle Line: skirts, feet, tails on truffles
quality.summary: Quality manager requested additional sampling after first-shift organoleptic test showed skirts/feet/tails on truffles and chocolate not glossy; production made adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved on shift — Jenny Medina confirmed adjustments in progress, no further flags posted.

quality.title: ML1 wrong recipe loaded at startup
quality.summary: Operator selected 'milk plain' (old) instead of 'milk plain new' at startup, causing temper instability; team changed recipe mid-shift and restarted tempering.
quality.status: Resolved — Shawn committed to delete old recipe to prevent recurrence.

sanitation.title: S1 condensed milk container left full overnight
sanitation.summary: Cleaning crew found condensed milk container full during morning setup; QA confirmed product not good, disposed in barrels (not down drain).
sanitation.status: Resolved — product disposed correctly; Marcos requested operators be informed when production ends to prevent unused ingredients sitting.

sanitation.title: ML4 Sweco screen clogged twice with cream return
sanitation.summary: North Sweco overflowed twice (01:57 and 03:29) due to scraper-return chocolate and cream residue; screen removed, washed, and passed ATP retest.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Janeth confirmed Sweco, scraper, and screen pass visual and ATP at 04:16 and 04:20.

opportunities.text: Consider adding kettle-bottom inspection to S2 pre-cook checklist — today's burnt residue flag after L4 clean suggests buildup can survive standard cleaning, based on QA finding significant char in A1 at 12:32.
Operators must be informed when S1 production is finished — today's condensed milk container left full overnight shows communication gap at shift handoff, based on Marcos's note at 12:27.

Reinforce reporting of damaged equipment on S2 — Leon found unreported chute damage (cut risk) during cart swap, suggesting operators are not flagging hazards when they occur, based on his report at 06:36.

Reinforce hopper purging procedure when ML3 is down >20 minutes — today's two cream-viscosity failures (86k→123k, 70k→37k) match the pattern Alan flagged when asking operators to purge every 20 minutes during downtime.

Consider deleting obsolete recipes from ML1 tempering unit — today's wrong-recipe incident echoes operator confusion when multiple versions exist, based on Imperial selecting 'milk plain' instead of 'milk plain new' at 06:34.

Consider adding scraper blade inspection to ML4 startup checklist — today's cream buildup and sweco clogs echo Tyson's observation that scraper was digging too deep and exposing cream, based on events at 01:57 and 03:29.
